canonical_view_rule: Primary inference includes each canonical patient-session-task once; release-specific unit/LFP views are linked sensitivity analyses and never independent cohorts.
registry_note: Widened 2026-08-04 (the anatomical census) from 13 to 16 entries: 'wolff_eeg_impulse', 'kai_miller_nback' and 'pfc3' were staged and analysed by existing scripts but were never registered here, so they were invisible to any rule reading dataset identity from this file. All three are required census subjects even though an earlier '13, no exceptions' count was written against the pre-widening file. This is a disclosed scope WIDENING, not narrowing. 'label_convention' is the per-dataset key the region-vocabulary parser dispatch reads -- declared here, never sniffed at runtime.

panichello_2024.label_convention_note: Sessions resolve to three monkey clusters by session-count/date grouping, not per-channel anatomy: 2021 (10 sessions, monkey A, area 8); 2022 (8 sessions, monkey H, area 8 and 9/46, undetermined which); 2024 (7 sessions, monkey J, area 9/46). Mapping is inferred from deposited session metadata, not depositor-confirmed; see results/corpus_staging_audit.json panichello_2024 entry for evidence and caveat.

watters_2026.modality_note: Was recorded as single_unit only, which undercounted what is staged: the shared per-trial spike cache carries 5228 multi-unit cluster files against 2857 well-isolated single-unit files across probes and sessions (results/watters_state_geometry.json quality-tier comparison), and both tiers are analysed.
